Step: 42 weeks + 7 days = 42*7 + 7 = 294 + 7 = 301 days.  
Subtract 301 days from 1793-08-21.  
1793 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400 if in Gregorian calendar; 1793 not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before Aug 21: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 → total before Aug 1 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31 = 212 days. Aug 21 is day 212+21 = 233 of year.  
233 - 301 = -68 days. Go to previous year: 1792 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not century exception in Gregorian).  
Days in 1792 = 366. 366 - 68 = 298th day of 1792.  
298 - 31 (Jan) - 29 (Feb) - 31 (Mar) - 30 (Apr) - 31 (May) - 30 (Jun) - 31 (Jul) - 31 (Aug) = 298-244 = 54.  
54 - 30 (Sep) = 24 → October 24, 1792.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1792-10-24
